Cmd+Shift+X · Ctrl+Shift+X → search → Install → Sign in. One is enough. Then open its own panel — not VS Code’s built-in Chat.

Vibe coding and agentic engineering

“Vibe coding”

Andrej Karpathy · February 2025 · the post that named it

There’s a new kind of coding I call “vibe coding”, where you fully give in to the vibes, embrace exponentials, and forget that the code even exists.

I “Accept All” always, I don’t read the diffs anymore.

It’s not too bad for throwaway weekend projects.

The same thing, named precisely

Simon Willison · October 2025

Vibe coding: the fast, loose and irresponsible way of building software with AI — entirely prompt-driven, and with no attention paid to how the code actually works.

He proposed a name for the other thing: vibe engineering — professionals who speed up with LLMs “while staying proudly and confidently accountable for the software they produce.”

Agentic engineering

Andrej Karpathy · Sequoia AI Ascent · 30 April 2026

Vibe coding raises the floor. Agentic engineering is about extrapolating the ceiling.

Agentic engineering is about preserving the quality bar of professional software. You are still responsible for your software, just as before.

What the difference is

Vibe coding

  • You look at what it does
  • The prompt is the whole plan
  • An error message goes straight back in
  • Done when it seems to work

Agentic engineering

  • You also look at how it does it
  • A spec, then a plan, then small steps
  • A failing test says what is wrong
  • Done when you can show it works

This course is about the second one

Agentic engineering.

Everyone takes away as much as they want.

A hint for using AI

The biggest problem is not that it hallucinates. It is that what it gives you is irrelevant.

Recommended method

  1. I think about the problem
  2. I ask the AI for a second opinion
  3. I decide — and move on
